description: OpenSSL 3.4.0 rejects unexpected alert(close_notify) messages in TLS 1.3 after a successful handshake, failing with 'unexpected message' error at record layer, while LibreSSL correctly processes them.     CheckAgentC(["protocol_config", "tls_version"], "V1_3"),
    StatusC(OSSL, in_error="unexpected message", first_executed_steps=None),
    TermContainsC(OSSL, "fn_alert_close_notify", last_input_executed=True)
)
